_comment: Model routing. Ladders start at sonnet (haiku removed 2026-07-18: in the sim build every S7 milestone attempted on haiku needed a sonnet retry; haiku kept only as a tier for manual use). Climb one rung per rollback, truncated at the level ceiling. Orchestrator pinned to sonnet.
policy: effective_ladder = ladders[step] truncated so no rung exceeds level_ceiling[level]. attempt 0 -> effective_ladder[0]. on rollback -> rung+1. on rollback at last rung -> escalate.
